items.title: Systems Selected for JIATF 401 Directed-Energy Counter-Drone Pilot Program
items.summary: The War Department announced the directed-energy systems selected following the Joint Interagency Task Force 401's counter-unmanned aircraft systems-directed energy pilot program, marking the next phase of efforts to expand the operational use of high-energy laser and high-powered microwave capabilities.

items.title: Escalating fighting in Yemen deepens food security crisis
items.summary: Renewed conflict in Yemen has triggered a surge in hunger that could have consequences in the wider region and beyond, the World Food Programme (WFP) warned on Friday.

items.title: Yemen escalation fuels fears of further cholera, measles spread
items.summary: Heavy fighting in Yemen is fuelling concerns of an uptick in cholera, measles and other preventable diseases, as overcrowding at displacement sites threatens to overwhelm the limited healthcare services still open.

items.title: Security Council LIVE: Ambassadors meet as West Bank tensions rise, Gaza plan stalls
items.summary: The Security Council met Monday morning with prospects for peace in the Middle East under strain on two fronts. In the West Bank, settler violence and settlement expansion are raising fears for a two-State solution. In Gaza, a year-old peace plan has stalled while civilian suffering continues. items.title: Yemen violence deepens concerns over child hunger crisis
items.summary: Aid agencies in Yemen highlighted the growing hunger emergency sparked by renewed fighting between Houthi opposition forces and Government troops, after mobile health clinics reported that hundreds of children displaced by the violence are suffering from the most deadly form of malnutrition.
